title: Reaching the goal at your pace

captions.physics: Moving work towards a chosen goal

meaning: You can pursue a shared undertaking firmly when determination makes room for the difference between your paces.
text: A shared aim can quickly set you in motion. The Chariot in the physical position of Manipura describes coordinated action: choosing a direction, arranging the steps and steering through difficulties. The Chariot in energy identifies the wish to overcome an obstacle, maintain determination and finish what you began. Temperance in emotions allows you to feel different paces combine into a rhythm that suits you both. It preserves effort while easing the inner struggle between needing to move and wanting to remain together along the way.

Suppose you carry a long shelf together. One person is ready to step while the other needs a better grip. **The shared result comes closer when movement is coordinated.** A brief pause lets you continue more confidently, and a turn becomes easier after a few words about the next step. Your determination gains a workable form through attention to the actual movement of two people, alongside the wish to finish.

The difficulty starts if coordinating seems an irritating delay. You accelerate towards the result, then have to soothe the irritation created by the pace itself. Emotional balance can become a habit of smoothing everything over after each rush. Work moves forward, but shared will is spent repairing the consequences of haste. A suitable rhythm preserves determination without demanding constant adjustment to a speed you never chose together.
